hits.label: q2
hits.asked: Side 5 cm se 10 cm: naya perimeter kitna? Hear
hits.reply: 160 nahi—square ka perimeter 4 times side hota hai; 10 cm side par perimeter 40 cm hoga. Ek rectangular kabaddi practice ground ka perimeter 146 m aur length 45 m hai. Iski breadth kitni hai?
